title: 003 杀倒霉风蛇！

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    原先无言所呆的空地上，此时，却是来了一个‘不速之客’。
一条身体呈现绿色，身周围着黑色条纹的花斑巨蛇缓缓的从森林的深处爬了过来，来到无言所处的空地上。
巨蛇有着接近四米的身体长度，宛如水桶般粗的腰身在空地上扭动爬行，巨大的蛇嘴上，两根比小棍子还粗的獠牙表示着其主人不是吃素的。
无言无耻的躲在一颗树上，小心翼翼的探着头，观察着这条巨蛇。
刚才，看到这系统示警的所谓‘危险’是这么一个主之后，无言差点把自己的小心肝给跳爆了，这种型号，在没有穿越之前的地球上，有没有存在无言不知道，但是能够指望只见过小猫小狗的无言见过这么凶残的乖乖吗？
要不是心中明白自己以后还要跟这种家伙‘打交道’，无言早就溜回老家去了，当然，前提是这个世界有他的老家。
看着巨蛇游行到空地上，无言心中感概，真应该说不愧是巨兽森林出品吗？
眼中闪过一道精光，无言眼中的巨蛇头上就多出了一行别人无法看到的字样。
风蛇：等级（10）。
这是一点运用系统的小技巧，是系统自带的能力，能够看到视线内对象的资料。
其实说是资料，也不过就是一个称呼，还有一个等级而已。
不过就是这样一个信息，也令无言差点连眼泪都流出来了。
这TM的可是10级的怪啊，什么不到百分之五的胜出率，以哥那光荣的0级别状态，有没有百分之一的胜出率都是一个问题呢，系统你又坑爹了…
虽然想是这么想，但是无言还是将自己的手搭在腰上的剑柄上，紧了紧手中的草薙剑剑柄，保持着随时都能出剑的姿势，无言双眼微微眯起，心中不断的思量着。
现在自己的机会只有一次，0级的自己对上10级的风蛇，不用说，那是妥妥的找死，这样的状况下，除非使用突袭的方式，才能给自己找到一丝胜机，而且必须是一击必杀！否则自己就死定了。
要是出手之后，还无法解决这条风蛇，无言就注定只能跑路了。
为了增加自己的胜率，无言觉得还是运用一点计策比较好。
眼睛盯着那巨大的风蛇，无言的意识飞快的沉入系统当中，然后，翻找着‘道具’类的物品。
道具点，不就是为了这个时候使用的吗？此时不用，更待何时？
很快的，无言就找到自己要的东西了。

醉仙花朵：能够释放一定量的花粉，强制性使吸收了花粉的对象陷入迷醉状态的，有几率让对象产生一定的幻觉；道具点1000点。
右手握着剑，无言的左手一翻，一朵看起来颇有点古色古香的精致花朵出现在他的手中，虽然不是没有比这更有用的道具，但是无言实在是囊中羞涩，而且这朵醉仙花也挺实用的，用来对付眼前的情况绝对合适。
抬起一只手，捂住自己的口鼻，无言心中嘿嘿狼笑了几声，举起另一只手中的花朵，轻轻的摇动了起来。
一阵肉眼无法看见的粉粒从花蕾中被无言摇出，缓缓的飘向风蛇，这一朵醉仙花最令人无语的地方，就是花粉不需要风来带动，只要将那花蕾对着一个方向，花粉就只会飘向那一个方向，就像手枪一样，是用来瞄准用的。
粉粒轻轻的飘向空地上的风蛇，或者是察觉到了危险，风蛇不安分的扭动着自己的蛇躯，一对绿色的蛇瞳不断的东张西望，嘴中的花信上下吐动，一副蓄势待发的姿势。
可惜，风蛇今天注定要栽在无言的手中，以它那不完整的神智，又怎么会想到，这次的对手，不是像以前的对手一样直接找上自己单挑，而是无耻的躲在一边，使用了一点‘卑鄙’的手段呢？
当然，也幸好风蛇没有智慧，不会产生这样的想法，要不然让无言知道了这样的想法，肯定会回它一句‘我是卑鄙我自豪’，让风蛇避免了被活活气死的结局。
随着时间的流逝，风蛇一对蛇瞳开始泛起水光，蛇眼皮一上一下的张合着，原本不断扭动的躯体扭得更加的欢快，只不过这回有点象是摇摆不定的感觉了。
看到这里，无言心中不由的一喜，他知道，自己的计策算是成功了，说真的，他还真怕蛇不会醉，毕竟他没跟蛇当过酒友…
渐渐的，风蛇口中发出一阵嘶喊声，好像是知道自己即将领便当一样，在这个世界发出龙套蛇的最后的哀嚎，而这样凄厉的叫声落到无言的耳中，就被他自动脑补为‘再来一杯’了，所以手中的醉仙花是摇得更加的用力！

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s copyright complaint fast track. In the empty space where I was speechless, an ‘uninvited guest’ came.
A giant spotted snake with a green body and black stripes around it slowly crawled out from the depths of the forest and came to the clearing where Wu Yan was.
The giant snake has a body length of nearly four meters, with a waist as thick as a bucket, twisting and crawling in the open space. On the huge snake's mouth, two fangs thicker than a small stick indicate that its owner is not a vegetarian.
Wu Yan shamelessly hid in a tree, cautiously raising his head and observing the giant snake.
Just now, after seeing that the so-called 'danger' warned by the system was from such a master, Wu Yan almost burst his heart. Wu Yan didn't know if this type of model existed on the earth before time travel, but could he expect Wu Yan, who had only seen kittens and puppies, to see such a ferocious obedient?
If he hadn't known in his heart that he would have to 'deal' with this kind of guy in the future, Wu Yan would have sneaked back to his hometown long ago. Of course, that's assuming there is a hometown for him in this world.
Watching the giant snake parade to the open space, Wu Yan felt in his heart, should it really be said to be a product of the Giant Beast Forest?
A flash of light flashed in Wu Yan's eyes, and there was a line of words on the head of the giant snake in Wu Yan's eyes that others could not see.
Wind Serpent: Level (10).
This is a little trick for using the system. It is the system's own ability to see the information of objects within sight.
In fact, it is just a title and a level.
But just such a piece of information made Wu Yan almost shed tears.
This damn monster is a level 10 monster. It has a winning rate of less than 5%. With my glorious level 0 status, whether there is a 1% winning rate is a question. You have tricked the system again...
Although he thought so, Wu Yan still put his hand on the hilt of the sword on his waist, tightened the hilt of the Kusanagi sword in his hand, and maintained a posture that could draw the sword at any time. Wu Yan narrowed his eyes slightly and kept thinking in his heart.
Now I only have one chance. When I am at level 0, I will face a level 10 wind snake. Needless to say, that is a sure way of seeking death. Under such circumstances, I can only find a chance to win by using a surprise attack, and it must be a one-hit kill! Otherwise, you will be dead.
If he still couldn't deal with this wind snake after taking action, Wu Yan would be destined to run away.
In order to increase his winning rate, Wu Yan thought it would be better to use some strategies.
Staring at the huge wind snake, Wu Yan's consciousness quickly sank into his system, and then he rummaged for 'props' items.
Isn’t the prop point just for use at this time? If you don’t need it now, when will you wait?
Soon, Wu Yan found what he was looking for.
Drunk Fairy Flower: It can release a certain amount of pollen, forcing the subject who has absorbed the pollen to fall into a state of intoxication. There is a chance that the subject will have certain hallucinations; 1000 prop points.
Holding the sword in his right hand, Wu Yan flipped his left hand, and a delicate flower that looked a bit antique appeared in his hand. Although there were more useful props than this, Wu Yan was really short of money, and this Drunken Fairy Flower was quite practical, and it was definitely suitable for dealing with the situation at hand.
Raising one hand to cover his mouth and nose, Wu Yan laughed a few times in his heart. He raised the flower in his other hand and shook it gently.
A burst of powder invisible to the naked eye was silently shaken out of the bud, slowly floating towards the wind snake. The most speechless thing about this flower is that the pollen does not need to be driven by the wind. As long as the bud is pointed in one direction, the pollen will only float in that direction, just like a pistol, which is used for aiming.
Powder particles float gently to the open spaceThe wind snake, perhaps aware of the danger, was twisting its snake body restlessly, its pair of green snake eyes constantly looking around, and the flower letter in its mouth was spitting up and down, as if it was ready to go.
It's a pity that Wind Snake is destined to fall into Wu Yan's hands today. With its incomplete mind, how could it have thought that this time its opponent would not directly come to challenge it like its previous opponents, but shamelessly hide aside and use some "despicable" means?
Of course, it was fortunate that the wind snake was not smart and would not have such an idea. Otherwise, if Wu Yan knew such an idea, he would definitely reply to it with "I am despicable and I am proud", which saved the wind snake from being pissed to death.
As time passed, the wind snake's pair of snake eyes began to glow with water, and the snake's eyelids opened and closed up and down. The originally twisting body became more and more cheerful, but this time it seemed a bit unsteady.
Seeing this, Wu Yan couldn't help but feel happy. He knew that his plan was successful. To be honest, he was really afraid that snakes wouldn't get drunk. After all, he had never been a drinking buddy with a snake...
Gradually, the wind snake let out a cry, as if it knew that it was about to receive lunch, and let out the last wail of a snake in a trap in this world. When such a shrill scream fell into Wu Yan's ears, he automatically thought of it as 'one more drink', so he shook the drunk fairy flower in his hand even harder!
